learning_outcomes.text: Students will acquire a broad basic knowledge of vehicle car bodies, their structural components, different constructions and forms.
Students will be taught the materials and corresponding joining techniques currently and in the near future used in car body technology.
Students will possess practice-oriented knowledge in car body technology.
Students are able to evaluate the structure and components of a car body and independently conceptualize and evaluate them.
They recognize the complex interrelationships between the structural components of a car body and can explain them.
Students apply subject-specific skills and abilities in familiar and unfamiliar contexts.
Students can apply the fundamental principles and aspects of car body technology in vehicle development.
Students can assess new technologies based on the acquired knowledge and incorporate them into the development process.
Students can communicate their ideas to colleagues and superiors in discussions and present them plausibly.
Students can evaluate and assess existing and future challenges in car body technology.

syllabus_topics: Joining Techniques in Car Body Construction
assessment_rules: The graded assessment is a written exam, as per the current study regulations. The ungraded assessment is experimental work, consisting of approximately 2-5 experiments. The graded exam will include calculation problems and comprehension questions related to car bodies, materials, and joining techniques in car body construction.
